title: Microsoft Power Pages is now available in Sweden Central and Italy North
summary: We’re excited to announce the general availability of Microsoft Power Pages in the Sweden Central and Italy North regions. Whether you’re a no-code, low-code, or code-first developer, Power Pages empowers you to build scalable, secure, and business-centric websites.
body_markdown:
We’re excited to announce the general availability of[Microsoft Power Pages](https://powerpages.microsoft.com/) in the **Sweden Central** and **Italy North** regions.


Whether you’re a no-code, low-code, or code-first developer, Power Pages empowers you to build scalable, secure, and business-centric websites. With pre-built templates and integrated tools to design, govern, and administer live sites, Power Pages provides a comprehensive platform for building and hosting external-facing business websites.


This regional expansion enables organizations to deploy Power Pages sites closer to their users while supporting regional data residency requirements.


With general availability in Sweden Central and Italy North, customers can access Power Pages capabilities including:


- **Power Pages Design Studio** to design and configure websites seamlessly
- **Template Hub** with ready-to-use business solution templates
- **Enhanced security and governance capabilities**
- **Seamless transition options for existing Power Apps portals customers**
- **Subscription-based Power Pages licensing**
- **Learn Hub** with curated documentation, guidance, and training resources


You can start building with Microsoft Power Pages through the[Power Pages maker portal](https://make.powerpages.microsoft.com/) .


Your feedback helps us continue improving Power Pages and delivering capabilities that meet the evolving needs of organisations around the world. We want to[hear from you](https://powerusers.microsoft.com/t5/Microsoft-Power-Pages-Community/ct-p/MPPCommunity) .


To learn more, explore the[Microsoft Power Pages documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/) .
